entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To check an order status, press 1. For returns or exchanges, press 2.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I think I need to make a return? I'm just so confused. I bought a jersey, but the website is a little overwhelming.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, um, I think so. It's... VF-98754. I hope that's right. It's just that the jersey is the wrong size. I finally tried it on and it's way too tight.
Okay, thank you. Let me pull that up. Yes, I see the order for the Men's Aero Jersey, delivered about 79 days ago. Is that correct?
79 days? Oh my. Is that too long? I saw so many different policies on the website, I couldn't figure out which one was for me. Can't you just help me? I just want to do an exchange for a larger size.

Of course. Let me just double-check our policy for that item. One moment... Okay, you're all set. That jersey falls under our 90-day return window, so you're well within the timeframe to make a return or exchange.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I was stuck with a jersey that's too tight. So you can help me with the exchange?
Absolutely. I've just processed the request and emailed you a pre-paid return label. Just send the original jersey back, and once it's scanned by the carrier, we'll ship out the next size up for you.
That's perfect. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this so easy.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer, and have a great day.
